metadata.purpose: Full 34-cell SHT FFT-target comparison for the plan-level N=1442 radix-103 root-pair cache
metadata.candidate_source_base: RustSHT-FFT M29 source plus M30 plan-level radix-103 root-pair cache
metadata.workload: All 34 current C2C and real SHT-target operation/length cells, including one-transform and scalar/spin-1 row batches; one transform thread
metadata.timing: Six alternating process pairs; seven warmed samples per operation
metadata.compiler: Rust 1.99.0 stable; optimized bench profile; portable x86_64 target; runtime AVX2 dispatch
metadata.cpu_model: AMD Ryzen 9 5950X; process pinned to logical CPU 30
metadata.dispatch_note: Only public f64 ComplexFftPlan::new(1442) builds the radix-103 root-pair table. The table adds 41,616 retained plan bytes, no workspace bytes, and about 2 microseconds of plan-construction time. f32, internal plans, unsafe inverse inputs, and non-AVX2 execution use existing routes.
metadata.runner: benches/results/m24-radix103/run_m24_clean_capture.py records process IDs, uptime, affinity, and load averages, and fsyncs each process record.
